look_up_country_and_network.description: Find out which country and continent an IP address is in and which network (AS number, name and domain) it belongs to, with IPinfo Lite, the free plan's unlimited lookup. Needs a free IPinfo access token on the connection.
look_up_country_and_network.display_name: Look up an IP address's country and network
look_up_country_and_network.display_str_template: Look up an IP address's country and network.
look_up_country_and_network.name: look_up_country_and_network

parameters.description: The IPv4 or IPv6 address to look up, such as 8.8.8.8 or 2001:4860:4860::8888. A private or reserved address (192.168.1.1, 10.0.0.1, 127.0.0.1) isn't looked up anywhere: the step answers with found set to false and bogon set to true.
parameters.name: ip_address

look_up_country_and_network.result_str_template: Look up an IP address's country and network completed.

as_domain.description: The network's website domain, such as google.com.

as_name.description: The network's name, such as Google LLC.

asn.description: The network's AS number, such as AS15169.

bogon.description: True when the address is private or reserved (a home or office network, loopback, multicast), so it has no public location.

continent.description: The continent's name, such as North America.

continent_code.description: The two-letter continent code, such as NA.

country.description: The country's name, such as United States.

country_code.description: The two-letter country code, such as US.

found.description: True when IPinfo had details for the address; false for a private or reserved address.

ip.description: The address that was looked up.

look_up_ip.description: Find out where an IP address is and who runs it: its city, region, country, postal code, coordinates and time zone, its hostname, the network (AS number and name) it belongs to, and whether it is anycast. Works without an IPinfo token.
look_up_ip.name: look_up_ip

parameters.description: The IPv4 or IPv6 address to look up, such as 8.8.8.8 or 2001:4860:4860::8888. A private or reserved address (192.168.1.1, 10.0.0.1, 127.0.0.1) isn't looked up anywhere: the step answers with found set to false and bogon set to true.
parameters.name: ip_address

look_up_ip.result_str_template: Look up an IP address completed.

anycast.description: True when the address is anycast: served from many places at once, so its location is only one of them.

asn.description: The network's AS number, such as AS15169, read from org.

bogon.description: True when the address is private or reserved (a home or office network, loopback, multicast), so it has no public location.

city.description: The city the address is in.

country.description: The two-letter country code, such as US.

found.description: True when IPinfo had details for the address; false for a private or reserved address.

hostname.description: The address's reverse DNS name, such as dns.google.

ip.description: The address that was looked up.

loc.description: The coordinates as one 'latitude,longitude' text value.

network_name.description: The network's name, such as Google LLC, read from org.

org.description: The network the address belongs to, as its AS number and name, such as 'AS15169 Google LLC'.

privacy.description: Whether the address is a VPN, proxy, Tor exit node, relay or hosting provider. Only IPinfo plans with privacy detection return it; otherwise null.

region.description: The state, province or region the address is in.

timezone.description: The IANA time zone, such as America/Los_Angeles.

description: Look up an IP address: its city, region, country, coordinates, time zone, hostname and network. Works without an account; a free token raises the limit.
